newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber unchanged after Tokyo falls.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber unchanged after Tokyo falls.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Friday, with falls in Tokyo seen dampening sentiment, dealers said.
"There are enquiries from Europe and Singapore which could lead to deals later in the day, but sentiment is weak on falls in Tokyo," one dealer in the west Sumatran city of Padang said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries were at 57.25-57.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 57.00-57.50 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 56.75-57.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
The Padang dealer said SIR20 fob Padang was last sold at 57.00 cents/lb for November deliveries.
Dealers said more fresh demand was likely to come from Europe after the summer holiday in the continent.
Dealers, however, said demand from Japan was likely to be weak in the coming days due to reports of higher rubber stock which fuelled concerns over near-term oversupply.
Dealers said there were no fresh latex deals heard.
High amoniac latex was on offer at 2,260 rupiah/kg in Tangerang and Bandung against the previous 2,350 rupiah due to weak demand. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
